title: 第1071章 老太爷钦定第1070章 合适人选
slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 铁秋雨拍了拍小手，没好气的看了楚风一眼，还是说道：“跟紧本姑娘，否则的话在铁家之内出了什么事，本姑娘可不搭理。”
铁秋雨一脸傲娇模样。
楚风微微别笑。
随即两人一前一后便也就是到了那铁家的正厅前堂之处。
来到此地，铁秋雨唤着下人去叫族长出面。
可是时间一分一秒的流逝过去，铁正义还没现身。
此时此刻，恐怕都看得出来这铁家之内定然是发生了什么她不知道的事情。
铁秋雨眉毛皱得越来越紧了。
恰在此时，外面也传来几道争吵声：“好一个铁家。好一个铁正义。在这青茅山上，铁正义的公允之名向来无人不知、无人不晓。
怎么？
现如今是欺负我上官家名声不显，所以便就可以在此处肆无忌惮了吗？
若是这般，今时今日同你铁家直接宣战又如何。”
“别忘记了，这场婚事当初可是两家的老太爷亲自发话的。
现如今，怎么就成了你们铁家一个人在这边说了算了？
还是说，当下之时铁家就这般的不顾一切、不顾这半分的名节，可以如此的肆无忌惮了？”
一道道的刺耳声音落下，至少此时此刻隐隐听上去，的的确确字字珠玑。
便是连着周围的铁家人，一个个的也同样哑口无言。
毕竟，说到底，此事也的的确确是他们铁家的人犯了错的。
否则，又怎么会只一味的防守而不做任何的反击？
这可完全不像是他们铁家人的做派。
能够在这青茅山、铁家、白家还有熊家之内，成为三家之处真正的霸主，铁家的一应长老以及那诸多的太乙金仙之境，还有大罗之境，可通通全部都是这实打实的狠人。
怎么会就轻易的丁点反应都没有？
这可一点不现实。
铁家众人脸色难看。
楚风刚刚来到此处，打量的目光朝旁边的铁秋雨，还有那位大小姐铁珊瑚望了一眼，随即表情间便也同样多出了几分淡淡的笑意。
“你这人，别告诉我此时此刻却是这般的幸灾乐祸起来了。
要知道，铁家的事情现如今可是和你上门的姑爷那也绝对都是息息相关的。
你不在这边帮忙也就算了，居然还要这般故意，是不是不太好？”
铁秋雨撅着粉唇，面目间透着几分淡淡的嗔怒之感，将此话老老实实的说出。
不过闻言，楚风淡然一笑。
恰逢旁边的铁家大小姐铁珊瑚也同样投过来了审视的目光，这下楚风却是必须要给出一个相应的解释才成了。
只见楚风耸了耸肩膀：“所谓联姻，而且还是昔日两位老太爷所允诺下来的。
如今铁家既然想要走到这一步，于情于理，也该付出些补偿才对。
可惜补偿太多，会让铁家的人在这边察觉得到猫腻；补偿的太少，铁家这头自然而然会更加的不甘心。
content_en:
Tie Qiuyu clapped her little hands, glanced at Chu Feng angrily, and said: "Follow me closely, otherwise, if something happens in the Tie family, I will ignore it."
Tie Qiuyu looked arrogant.
Chu Feng smiled slightly.
Immediately, the two of them arrived at the main hall of the Tie family, one after the other.
Arriving here, Tie Qiuyu called his servants to ask the clan leader to come forward.
But time passed by minute by minute, and Tie Zhengyi had not yet appeared.
At this moment, she could probably tell that something must have happened in the Tie family that she didn't know about.
Tie Qiuyu frowned more and more tightly.
At this time, several quarrels came from outside: "What a Tie family. What a Tie Zhengyi. On this Qingmao Mountain, Tie Zhengyi's fair name has always been known to everyone.
What?
Now you are bullying me because the Shangguan family has a low reputation, so you can act unscrupulously here?
If this is the case, what if we declare war directly with your Tie family today? "
"Don't forget, the old man of the two families personally spoke about this marriage.
Now, why is it that your Tie family alone has the final say here?
Or is it that the Tie family is so desperate and disregards even half of their reputation at the moment, can they be so unscrupulous? "
A series of harsh sounds fell, at least at this moment, it sounded faintly, and every word was accurate.
Even the Tie family members around them were all speechless.
After all, in the final analysis, it was indeed the Tie family's fault.
Otherwise, how could they just defend without any counterattack?
This is completely unlike the behavior of their Iron Family.
To be able to become the real overlord of the three families in Qingmao Mountain, Tie Family, Bai Family and Xiong Family, the Tie Family's elder Yiying and the many Taiyi Golden Immortal Realm and Da Luo Realm are all really ruthless people.
How could it be that there was no reaction at all?
This is not realistic at all.
Everyone in the Tie family looked ugly.
Chu Feng had just arrived here and glanced at Tie Qiuyu and the eldest lady Tie Hualou, and then his expression also showed a faint smile.
"You man, don't tell me that you are so gloating at this moment.
You know, the affairs of the Tie family are absolutely closely related to your uncle who comes to visit you.
It doesn't matter if you're not here to help, but you still want to be so intentional, isn't it bad? "
Tie Qiuyu pursed her pink lips, with a hint of anger on her face, and said these words honestly.
But after hearing this, Chu Feng smiled lightly.
Coincidentally, the eldest daughter of the Tie family, Tie Hualou, also cast a scrutinizing gaze next to her. Now Chu Feng had to give a corresponding explanation.
Chu Feng shrugged his shoulders: "The so-called marriage was promised by the two old masters in the past.
Now that the Tie family wants to get to this point, it is reasonable to pay some compensation.
It's a pity that if the compensation is too much, the Tie family will notice something fishy here; if the compensation is too little, the Tie family will naturally be even more unwilling.
